text:
megan: Canary looks stuck at 3% for slice `us-west-2-a`. Flag console shows rollout at 3% for 25m and no traffic growth. Anyone watching infra? cc @devon @sanjay

devon: I noticed errors in the gatekeeper logs around the same time — several `capacity_limit` entries for that GPU pool.

sanjay: Gateway is returning 429s -> rate limiter tripped on that slice. Rolling window + token bucket settings are too aggressive for the spike pattern.

alex: I opened PR #4523 to relax the slice rate limiter and add a short backoff jitter, but it hasn't been approved yet. ETA for review ~20m if someone can take it.

megan: If we want to progress canary to 10% now, can we do a manual override? Also what's the rollback play if p50/p95 jump?

devon: We can apply a temporary FF override in the runtime: set `canary_percent: 10` for that feature flag. Rollback is immediate: set to 0 or revert to previous flag. Also we have an automated fallback that detects p95 > 2000ms and will cut traffic to baseline model.

megan: Share the exact quick command/config so oncall/dev can run it.

sanjay: Quick snippet (runtime override via admin API):
```
POST /admin/flags/override
{
  "flag": "ff.canary.us-west-2-a",
  "value": { "canary_percent": 10 },
  "reason": "manual bump for staged rollout while rate-limit PR reviews"
}
```

alex: Also note: if we bump, enable the temporary surge autoscaler policy: `autoscale: aggressive-10pct` — that will allow pods to spin up faster for the next 5m. PR touches that config too.

ci-bot: deploybot: Canary override request recorded by megan at 1745032100. No automated rollout executed (pending manual API call).

paula: I'll run smoke + latency checks if someone triggers the override. Planning: curl + 100 requests spread over 30s to a test route, monitor p50/p95 and error rate. Will report in 10m.

megan: Plan: (1) @alex or @devon approve/apply PR to relax limiter ASAP, (2) @devon or @alex run admin API override to 10%, (3) @paula run smoke tests and report metrics, (4) rollback to 0% if p95 > 2s or 5% errors.

alex: On it — will approve PR and then coordinate with devon for the override.

devon: Ready to run override and monitor. If we see >3% errors I'll trigger rollout cut.

paula: Running smoke now (starting at 1745032245). Initial p50=120ms p95=210ms error=0. Re-running after override.

paula: After override (1745032340): p50=150ms p95=420ms error=0.9% — within acceptable thresholds, keeping watch.

megan: Awesome. I'll leave the thread open for 30m but list this as green for now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
